Ready for the maintainer to merge.

The change meets issue #2336:
- The change deletes only the two unused screenshots in `docs/images/pr-1639-workbench/`.
- A search of the tracked text found no references to these screenshots.
- All four `docs/images/first-part-*.png` tutorial images remain unchanged.

Local checks:
- The trial merge with `upstream/main` at `4e8616b81a43795a8587fa70e84045fb4065c190` required no changes. The PR already contains that commit.
- `cargo xtask gate quick --base upstream/main --dry-run`: passed.
- `cargo xtask gate quick --base upstream/main`: passed; 0 steps, 0 failed.
- The gate built `xtask`. It selected no product builds or tests because no file in `crates/` changed. No crate tests or clippy ran.

This change does not affect G-code, geometry, stock simulation, collision checks or gouge checks. No mutation tests apply. No UI code or test goldens change.

Requested changes: none.

Note: The deletion removes the images from the current tree. It does not remove their data from Git history.

A maintainer will approve and merge by hand.
